review: independent visual review of original native-v4 screenshots

observations.seed: The 20 BPM and 400 BPM authored readouts are visible on Cards 1 and 2. The Manual-wait capture shows the run still active on Card 3. Core-duration and PCM refusal captures show readable notices attributed to Set 1 and the relevant Card. The retry capture shows the run active on Card 5 with Manual timing at 400 BPM; the final seed capture shows Card 5 retained as Manual at 400 BPM with Run available.
observations.reopen: The reopened view shows Card 5/5 selected, Hold: manual, and 400 bpm, with Run available and no refusal notice. This visually matches the intended retained timing state.

issues.detail: The intentionally enormous Seconds values make the hold controls unusually wide. The refusal notices remain readable and correctly attributed; this did not block review.

limits: This is visual evidence only. It cannot establish exact persisted timing bits, phase hashes, process exit status, sealed-session custody, audio output, or that the reopen occurred in a fresh process. Those require the independent source, process, and checkpoint receipts. No other phase artifacts or live UI were inspected.
